Only a few edges are drawn here. A backend
declares a capability only when it serves
every method of it, so what only the
in-process backend can do sits on a
capability of its own, such as
through getCore(), so no step resolves it:
the layer lint rejects it under src/Steps.
The root of src/Backend references no Drupal
class; everything that is Drupal's sits under
scenario's backend order and returns the first
instance of the capability a step asked for,
